## Verified on main
[Dependabot PR #237](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-starter/pull/237) passed [PR CI](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-starter/actions/runs/45530804174) after regenerating the changelog. Its squash landed at [`41b03333bce48cbdcfab7b40cc483769830f9f4f`](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-starter/commit/41b03333bce48cbdcfab7b40cc483769830f9f4f). The commit preserves an unreleased `Bump @unbrained/pm-cli` bullet, but generation on that exact main commit wants the full version-bump entry with the #237 link.

The subsequent [main CI Deep run](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-starter/actions/runs/45604956732) failed all four lanes. I read the [Node 26 npm](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-starter/actions/runs/45604956732/job/139173355866) and [Node 26 Bun](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-starter/actions/runs/45604956732/job/139173355355) logs: both reach `changelog:check` and fail with `Drift classification: tracker_changed` and the same one-line replacement. In a disposable cloud Git clone with history/tags, Node 24.22.3, the main lockfile, and install scripts disabled, `npm ci --ignore-scripts --audit=false --fund=false` then `npm run changelog:check` independently produced the same result. No source edit, release, or provider write was needed for validation.

The next dependency PR [#238](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-starter/pull/238) also hits the gate: [Node 26 quick release job](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-starter/actions/runs/45738862148/job/139638632896) passed 226 tests and the coverage threshold and then failed `changelog:check`. Its diff includes the same full entry for #237 plus the candidate's grouped dependency update. This is CI/release-gate drift, not evidence of a package runtime failure or an outage on the self-hosted runners.

## Expected and acceptance
- Keep `CHANGELOG.md` reproducible across the real dependency PR and its normal squash/merge path, or reconcile it safely on that path before the next release gate. Do not make the check permissive or remove meaningful dependency attribution.
- Recover current main through the normal reviewed workflow, preserving published version sections and dependency entries as in [#234](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-starter/pull/234).
- Add a regression with a bot dependency commit, its changelog refresh, and the squash result (including the PR suffix). Check which input changes after merge and prove fresh PR and post-squash snapshots are handled intentionally; keep a negative control for genuinely stale changelogs.
- Re-run the read-only check at the repaired immutable head and verify both npm and Bun CI gates. The unrelated scheduled GitHub issue-import refusal is out of scope for this ticket.

Dedup: searched all-status issue and PR records and the repository's PM tracker; #234 addresses retention in published sections, while #238 is the affected dependency update itself.
